zone_risk_explanation.natural_language_template: This zone is marked as {risk_class} risk because today’s rainfall overlaps with high built-up density, dense road coverage, and limited vegetation. The score is model-estimated and not an official flood report.

rule_templates.explanation: High rainfall on dense built-up surface leading to heavy surface runoff.
Low-lying topographic depression susceptible to water accumulation.

route_explanation.natural_language_template: The weather-safe route is recommended because it avoids road segments crossing {severity_level}-risk rain impact zones. It reduces estimated route risk by {risk_reduction_pct}% with a {eta_tradeoff_min}-minute ETA tradeoff.

future_shap_integration.requirements: Install shap package safely and run TreeExplainer on Random Forest model to yield local shap values for each zone.

proposed_endpoints.description: Get natural language and factor-based risk explanation for a specific zone
Compare normal and safe routes, returning segment-by-segment hazard contributions and ETA/risk tradeoffs
Get global feature importance and permutation importance metrics for the current model
